The override is an enrollment-local annotation over SIS data, not a writeback. The SIS value is kept and returned alongside it, and the correction keeps winning over later SIS imports until staff revisit it.
The corrected value is shared by every student linked to the contact. `studentId` in the body only records whose screen the edit came from.

get.summary: Reads a contact's override history, newest first.
get.description:
Eventually consistent. A change reaches the log through Enrollment's outbox, so an entry can be a few seconds behind a write that has already succeeded. Render the current value from the contact itself and use this for what preceded it.
One route for both details, unlike the writes: this is a single ordered log and each entry names its own detail, so splitting it would mean two requests to render one contact's timeline and two page counts to reconcile.

put.summary: Updates an Enrollment Contact name and its linked students.
put.description:
The student list is REPLACED, not merged: a student omitted from the body is unlinked from the contact.
Email and phone cannot be changed here. Correcting either is an override, which records who changed it and keeps the SIS value beside the correction; a body carrying `email` or `phone` is rejected with a 400 naming the route to use instead. Note that a contact whose email is overridden keeps that override across this call - an update to the name leaves a standing correction alone.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: A student to link the contact to.

tenantId.description: Must match the tenant in the route.

contactId.description:
The contact's identifier in the source system. Distinct from the record id, which the service
assigns and returns in the response.

firstName.description: Required. Never overridable - only email and phone are.

lastName.description: Required. Never overridable - only email and phone are.

email.description:
The SIS-sourced email. Correcting it later is an override and goes through the
`email-override` route instead - see EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpdateContactRequestDto.

phone.description: The SIS-sourced phone, on the same terms as Email.

students.description:
The students to link the contact to. Optional; omit or send an empty list for a contact with no
links yet.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: The body of a contact creation.
The body of a contact update.

value.description: The corrected detail. The DELETE route removes an override instead; this is never blank.

studentId.description:
The student whose screen the edit was made from. Recorded on the history entry so it can be
filtered per student. It does NOT scope the override — every student linked to the contact shares
one corrected value.

expectedVersion.description:
The `lastUpdatedDateTime` the client read, round-tripped back. When it no longer matches the
write is refused with 412 rather than winning because it arrived second. Omit to skip the check.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: The body of an override write.
What a contact create or update reports back.

detail.description: Which detail this entry is about: `email` or `phone`.

action.description: `set` or `removed`. A removal returns the detail to its SIS value.

previousValue.description: The value this entry superseded, if any. Superseded values are kept, never deleted.

actingStudentId.description: The student whose screen the change was made from, when one was recorded.
